analysis: The question asks for a topical immunomodulator used in the treatment of genital warts. Imiquimod is a well-known topical immunomodulator that works by activating the immune system to fight against the human papillomavirus (HPV) that causes genital warts. Podophylline is also used for genital warts but acts through a cytotoxic mechanism, not as an immunomodulator. Interferon is an immunomodulator but is not typically used topically as a first-line treatment for genital warts. Acyclovir is an antiviral medication used for herpes simplex virus infections, not for genital warts. Based on standard medical knowledge and consensus, Imiquimod is the most appropriate choice for a topical immunomodulator used in the treatment of genital warts.
